Welcome to South Asheville Veterinary Emergency & Specialty (SAVES)
Providing veterinary emergency and specialty care to Asheville, Fletcher, and surrounding Western North Carolina
Pet Owners
Part of caring for patients is educating and guiding family members on how to make decisions that are in the best interest of their beloved pets, both in the hospital and at home.
Services
In addition to having board-certified specialists and state-of-the-art diagnostics and equipment, our team serves as Asheville's resource for veterinary emergency care, whatever you and your pet need.
Our Team
We work alongside pet families and primary care veterinarians to bring together medical knowledge, technology, and kindness for exceptional patient care.

Client Reviews & Testimonials
The team at South Asheville Veterinary Emergency & Specialty has been dedicated to providing quality veterinary care to the Asheville, NC community. We strive to treat your pets with the same care and compassion as if they were our own.
SAVES is expert, meticulous, and caring. We brought our puppy Cleo to SAVES for surgery. They are super responsive, have a team that is truly exceptional, and work together to solve problems. Also, their facility is super clean and orderly—at the level of a first-rate human hospital. Highly recommend!
Michelle M.
SAVES did just what its name implies. They saved our newly adopted shepherd mix from pneumonia. I can't say enough great things about this wonderful animal hospital in Asheville. Very professional teams worked nothing short of a miracle.
Rosemarie S.
Everyone here is compassionate, caring, and thorough. My dog had to have emergency surgery which resulted in a couple days of staying there. They called every morning with an update, let me visit her every evening, and continue to help me with any questions I’ve had since bringing her home. I can’t thank them enough for saving my dog’s life!
Sky D.
